headline: Ohio State leads the conference, beaten twice all season
dek: Ohio State has won 16 times and conceded 11 goals all season, and only UCLA and Michigan have beaten it. Purdue and UCLA sit level on points behind it, with Michigan State just below them.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Scoring has not settled the table: Purdue's two defeats all season came against Ohio State, which leads it, and UCLA, which is level with it on points.

wire.line: Purdue has scored 78 goals, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches from August are past their date with no result published: Minnesota away at Iowa State and Michigan at home against Xavier.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jaiden Anderson has scored 20 goals from 102 shots for Purdue.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Kennedy Bell has ten goals and twelve assists for Michigan State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Nebraska has drawn ten times this season, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Izzy Lee has made 88 saves for Illinois at a .838 save percentage.

last_match.line: Only Purdue has scored more goals in the conference than Michigan State this season.

next_match.line: Ohio State is unbeaten outside the conference this season; Tennessee has already beaten Rutgers and Northwestern.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
